We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences. Vehicle OS is Applied Intuition’s software platform for SDV. It enables OEMs to modernize their E/E architecture through three interconnected areas: - Middleware & architecture Service-oriented, middleware-driven software stacks built on AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform, SOME/IP, and DDS. Helps OEMs migrate from distributed ECU architectures to zonal, centralized compute. - Developer toolchain A code-first toolchain that replaces GUI-bound configuration workflows. Engineers model vehicle behavior in Python, manage changes through pull requests, and validate in virtual ECU environments analogous to what cloud virtual engineering workbenches (e.g., AWS VEW) brought to cloud-native development, but purpose-built for automotive E/E systems. - IVI & in-vehicle infotainment Android Automotive OS (AAOS) based platform, HMI/cluster software, and intelligent in-cabin experiences including Cabin Intelligence (DMS, OMS, voice, occupant interaction). This role sits at the intersection of all three areas, and the balance will depend on the customer mix. AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL: - Act as the technical bridge between automotive customers and Applied Intuition’s engineering and product teams - Support OEMs in adopting Vehicle OS: middleware stack, developer SDK, and IVI/infotainment integration - Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, demos, and early-stage deployments with OEM and Tier 1 engineering teams - Help customers adopt Applied’s code-first developer toolchain, onboarding engineering teams onto the SDK, setting up virtual ECU environments, and integrating with customers’ existing CI/CD pipelines - Guide OEMs through the design and implementation of service-oriented vehicle architectures and support system integration across ECUs, domain controllers and high-performance compute - Work with customers’ IVI and infotainment teams on AAOS integration, Linux-based IVI stack deployment, HMI/cluster software, and Cabin Intelligence features (driver monitoring, occupant monitoring, voice/AI interaction) - Collaborate with customers and internal product teams to triage and resolve technical issues - Manage project milestones and communicate progress across multiple customer and internal stakeholders WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS: - 3+ years of experience working with automotive OEMs or suppliers, ideally in SDV, E/E architecture, developer tooling, or in-vehicle infotainment/IVI - Experience with AUTOSAR (Classic or Adaptive) and automotive developer tooling - Familiarity with vehicle communication protocols: SOME/IP, DDS, CAN, LIN, or automotive Ethernet - Experience with at least one of the following: - - Vehicle software developer toolchain: SDK-based development, virtual ECUs, SIL environments, or CI/CD pipelines for automotive software - IVI / infotainment platforms: Android Automotive OS (AAOS), Linux-based IVI, HMI/cluster software, or display middleware - Execution-driven mindset with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple customer engagements in parallel - Experience working directly with customers on complex problems at the intersection of software and vehicle systems - Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field - Basic / intermediate programming experience in C/C++, Python, or similar - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German and/or additional European language is a significant plus NICE TO HAVE: - Hands-on experience with Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS or a comparable SDV platform - Knowledge of zonal E/E architectures, HPC platforms, or software-defined networking in vehicles - Experience with OTA systems and vehicle software lifecycle management - Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety or SOTIF in the context of IVI or ADAS systems - Experience with Cabin Intelligence technologies: driver monitoring (DMS), occupant monitoring (OMS), or in-cabin perception and AI - Exposure to perception systems or AI/ML pipelines applied to in-vehicle experiences - Experience with simulation environments or digital twin platforms to validate vehicle software - Project management experience in cross-functional, customer-facing programs BENEFITS: - 30 days of paid vacation per year - Daily meal benefits: €19 lunch budget and €19 dinner budget, free breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office - You’ll receive €965 annual learning & development and €580 annual fitness budget - Subsidized Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms, studios, and wellness facilities across Germany - Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight. In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns. - Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware. - Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes). - Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification. - System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams. - Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred). - Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker). - Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters. - Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or Shell scripting for automation, test suite creation, and processing flight data logs. - Protocols: Direct experience working with serial and vehicle bus protocols (UART, CAN, Ethernet, SPI, I2C). - Leadership: Ability to lead major integration efforts independently and act as the technical link between software, GNC, and hardware teams. NICE TO HAVE - Active DoD Secret Security Clearance. - Deep experience with the MAVLink protocol and autopilot hardware (PX4, ArduPilot). - Experience with Persistent Systems, Silvus, or similar tactical mesh radios. - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate and hands-on R/C flight experience. - Background working with defense tech platforms or flight ranges. Security Requirements: - Must be a U.S. Citizen - Must hold or be eligible for a U.S. Secret security clearance For more information about U.S. security clearances: click here https://www.state.gov/securityclearances. Who we are Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver https://aurora.tech will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech http://aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/auroradriver. What we are looking for Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We’re searching for a Service Engineering Technician to join our team. This role will be focused on developing and validating a variety of complex repair strategies, and collaborating cross-functionally throughout our hardware organization, including our Systems, Reliability, Vehicle Integration and Fleet Operations teams to troubleshoot and upgrade Aurora Driver components. This position requires great attention to detail, excellent cross-team communication, documentation, and a solid diagnostic foundation. Must be comfortable solving difficult challenges, ready to roll up the sleeves to expedite repairs, and have a constant eye for quality. Must have experience using OEM diagnostic tools, methodologies, and a logical troubleshooting approach. In this role, you will - Work closely with Vehicle Operations, Software, and Hardware performing diagnostics, test-plans, and vehicle upgrades. - Perform maintenance on complex mechanical and electrical components. - Document and communicate findings through internal processes - Take ownership and escalate data or findings when appropriate - Perform quality service and repair, work cross-functionally, and bring a can-do team spirit. - Maintain a clean and professional workspace. - Capable of balancing and prioritizing multiple tasks. - Mechanical aptitude: Assemble or build parts or jigs for prototypes, proficiency with mechanical fabrication (drill press, saws, hand tools, etc.). - Testing procedures: Build and setup test rigs for mechanical and/or electrical tests across multiple teams (Hardware, Systems, Devs...etc.). - Provides feedback, creates and implements processes and suggestions to new and/or improved workshop standards, protocols, and processes. Required Qualifications - At least 3- 6 years OEM Technician Experience - At least 1-3 years AV and or Electric Vehicle experience - Solid diagnostics chops - Demonstrate knowledge of basic workshop etiquette, provide verbal and writing communication across all teams (No jerks) - Prior experience with JIRA Desirable Qualifications - Direct manufacturing and prototyping experience a bonus - Prior experience working with autonomous vehicles - Experience with CAN bus issues The hourly wage range for this position is $35.75 - $51.75 per hour. Aurora's pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate's starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for benefits. Working at Aurora At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week. Our Careers page https://aurora.tech/careers provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom https://aurora.tech/newsroom. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. job_description: Bei Bosch Rexroth dreht sich alles um Bewegung und den Erfolg unserer Kunden. job_name: Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer for Analog Frontends and ADCs (f/m/div.)
job_description: At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch. The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application! Semiconductors are far more than tomorrow’s key technology. They are our core business – already today. Get on board and join us on this journey. Become part of an inspiring team at Bosch committed to develop leading-edge ASICs and SoCs. For innovating sustainable, safe and fascinating solutions for the mobility of tomorrow. As a Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Engineer for Analog Frontends and ADCs you develop high performance analog interface circuits (incl. ADC/DAC) for mixed-signal SoC ASICs in automotive sensor modules. Examples are low noise frontends for ultrasound sensors, frontends for inertial sensors with very low offset drift or high speed frontends for radar applications. Therefore, you support drive layout and series test program development. In close collaboration with our customers, you define precise requirements for new circuit solutions and translate them into detailed technical specifications. Furthermore, you develop and evaluate innovative concepts for signal analysis and processing, always focusing on achieving leading-edge solutions. In your position, designing and verifying high-performance amplifiers, analog filters, ADCs, DACs, and dedicated supporting circuits are among your core responsibilities. In addition, you create reference models of the complete signal path using Matlab/Simulink and/or Verilog-A to comprehensively simulate and validate functionality. Last but not least, you take responsibility for validating samples and evaluating characterization and qualification results to ensure the quality of our products. Education:  completed university studies in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable subject Experience and Knowledge: practical experience in IC design, particularly in the design of low-noise amplifier and converter circuits; in-depth knowledge of semiconductor processes and solid-state devices; experience with state-of-the-art EDA software tools for schematic entry, simulation, layout, and design flows; practical experience with Matlab/Simulink Personality and Working Practice:  you are able to drive complex technical topics forward across departmental boundaries; you work in a structured, responsible, and goal-oriented manner; you communicate clearly and coordinate effectively within the team Work Routine:  while we embrace a hybrid working model, we primarily collaborate on site to foster close teamwork and direct exchange; depending on project requirements and day-to-day responsibilities, the level of on-site presence will be aligned Languages: very good German and English skills, both written and spoken Application deadline up to and including 16th of September 2026. In accordance with our regulations, the gross annual salary for this position is at least EUR 88.000 for a 35h week (for a full year of employment and fulfillment of the eligibility requirements based on collective agreements) in the case of a comprehensive execution of job requirements. In addition, there is an individual, performance-related pay, a bonus based on the company's success, as well as employer benefits for the Bosch pension plan. We will be happy to discuss further details of our remuneration package, as well as (remuneration) development opportunities, with you during the application process. We offer flexible working models: from various part-time options to mobile working and job sharing. Feel free to contact us.
